main_text.p: φόβος αἱματοθνῆσον τῆς οδύνης ἔλυσεν, mortis metus me sensu doloris privavit.

Pertinet huc adjectivum in ιχός. Procl. γωσικὴ δὲ μεγεθῶν ἢ σημάτων ἡ γεωμετρία, speculativa est magnitudinum & figurarum, Geometria. Aristot. φυλακτικὸν σωματος ὑγεία, conservativum corporis, sanitas.
Quædam generis hujus dativo serviunt. Linus,
᾿Ραδίᾳ πάντα Θεῷ τελέσαι, ᾧ αἰλιότερον ουδὲν.
Facilia omnia Deo facitu, & impossibile nihil.
Adjectiva quædam serviunt infinito, ut Latinis supino vel gerundio. Homerus,
Ἰφαλέος γὰρ τ' ἐστὶ Θεὸς βεβαιωσ αὐδρὶ δαμῆναι,
Difficilis etenim est Deus mortali viro do-

page.notes: Greek text is printed in a cursive, partly worn state; Greek readings are approximate. Several words in the Greek lines (e.g. the Linus and Homer verses) are doubtful. The page is damaged at the left edge and bottom.
